newsitem.title: USA: 13-year-old charged with murder in United States.
newsitem.headline: 13-year-old charged with murder in United States.

text.p: A 13-year-old boy has been charged with shooting an Atlanta man three times in the chest in front of his two young sons, a crime that city officials condemned on Wednesday as a shocking, cold-blooded murder.

The juvenile, whose name was not released because of his age, was charged with the murder of Darrell Woods, who was sitting in his car with his 2- and 5-year-old sons, while his wife went into a supermarket to purchase a soft drink.
Witnesses said a male came up to Woods' car and fired three shots before running away. "He was just shot without any explanation," police chief Beverly Harvard said.

"It is hard for any of us to imagine that a 13-year-old could have the will to kill another human being, certainly not in cold blood, as seems to be the facts in this case," Atlanta Mayor Bill Campbell told reporters.
"This heinous homicide points to all the things that are wrong with this society," Campbell said.

The accused teenager's 19-year-old brother and a 22-year-old man were in the city jail on Wednesday on charges of being a party to the Jan. 21 murder. Police said they have not determined a motive for the shooting.
